name: Darkspawn Culinary Brewing
description: Six culinary potion families (16 potions): Herbal Restoration, Pepper Haste, Dairy Guard, Truffle Vigor, Marsh Breath and Frostfire Tonic. Each family is brewable when the mod that grows or harvests its reagent is installed (farming or husbandry); the long and strong upgrades use vanilla reagents.
